epic.title: Parent Conduct & Behavioral Oversight Module
epic.body: Enables parents to monitor behavioral feedback, disciplinary remarks, and academic attitude logs for their children, facilitating a two-way communication channel between home and school.

features.title: Behavioral Remarks & Timeline
features.body: Provides parents with a chronological view of remarks posted by teachers regarding their child's conduct, attitude, and disciplinary incidents.

stories.title: Student Conduct Timeline Interface
stories.body: As a parent, I want to view a timeline of behavioral remarks for my child so I can stay informed about their school conduct.
acceptanceCriteria: List: Chronological list of remarks showing the Author (Teacher), Category, and Date.
Categorization: Visual labels for 'Academic', 'Discipline', and 'Attitude' types.
Details: Expandable cards to view the full text of the remark.
Context: Dynamic update of remarks when switching between different child profiles on the dashboard.

stories.title: Conduct Remark Retrieval API
stories.body: API endpoints to fetch behavioral logs and remarks scoped to the children linked to the authenticated parent.
acceptanceCriteria: List: GET endpoint to retrieve all remarks for a specific studentId.
Security: Restrict data access to verified parent accounts associated with the student.
Filtering: Support server-side filtering by category (Academic/Discipline/Attitude).

features.title: Two-way Conduct Communication
features.body: Allows parents to acknowledge and respond to remarks posted by teachers to ensure collaborative student development.

stories.title: Parent Feedback & Acknowledgement Interface
stories.body: Interface for parents to add comments or acknowledgements to specific behavioral remarks.
acceptanceCriteria: Create: Form to add a parent comment/reply to a specific teacher remark.
Interaction: Display a threaded view of teacher remarks and subsequent parent replies.
Acknowledgement: Visual indicator showing if a parent has read/viewed a critical disciplinary remark.

stories.title: Remark Interaction & Feedback API
stories.body: API logic to handle parent replies and update the status of conduct remarks.
acceptanceCriteria: Create: POST endpoint for parents to add replies to an existing remark ID.
Update: PUT/PATCH endpoint to mark a remark as 'Acknowledged' by the parent.
Delete: Ability for a parent to delete their own replies/comments.
